about.title: Driven by learning, innovation & problem-solving
paragraphs: I'm a passionate **Full Stack Software Engineer** and **aspiring AI researcher**. I'm driven by a passion for learning, innovation, and problem-solving.

I hold an Engineering degree in Computer Science from **ENSA Kénitra**. I work across the stack, from machine learning models and LLM agents to backend services, web interfaces and the CI/CD pipelines that deliver them.
I currently work at **Orange Business**, building business web applications and an internal AI chatbot. I care about software quality, performance and measurable impact.

skills.title: Skills & tools
skills.subtitle: From research notebooks to production systems: the tools I use to design, build and ship.

bullets: Design and develop business web applications using Python, PHP, JavaScript and SQL.
Optimized SQL/MariaDB queries and processing, contributing to an estimated **30% reduction in ticket processing time**.
Built an internal **AI-powered chatbot** automating recurring authentication & access-management support requests.
Implemented authentication, role-based access control and permission management.
Delivered through Git/GitLab, Docker and CI/CD in an Agile team, with code reviews and technical documentation.
Developed FastAPI services exposing computer vision capabilities through production REST APIs.
Contributed to an AI solution for **player re-identification** using computer vision.
Implemented a real-time data streaming pipeline with **Apache Kafka**.
Set up CI/CD workflows and deployed services on **AWS**.
Built Python automation scripts for VoIP invoice validation and data processing.
Designed REST APIs with Flask for backend services.
Contributed to an **MLOps pipeline** for customer detection with Airflow, MLflow and DVC.
Implemented monitoring with the ELK Stack and containerized services with Docker.
Developed a predictive maintenance model from infrared thermal images and vibration signals.
Built an API and interactive interface to expose model predictions.
Built sales forecasting models for SIM cards, dealers and scratch cards across three Moroccan telecom operators.
Data analysis and visualization with Python, Scikit-learn, R and Power BI.
